text.p: The following is a simple average

Sources: Argentaria, BBV, BoA, ICAE, C. Madrid, Beta Capital,

PPI - Industrial producer prices, released by the National Statistics Institute (INE) - Next data due 11/11
IPI - Industrial production (INE), year on year - 27/11
Jobless - Variation in numbers of registered unemployed, in thousands of persons (* Figures are 1996 over 1995) - between 8/11 and 12/11
EPA - Quarterly survey of employment levels (INE). Data give variation in employed persons, in thousands - 26/11
GDP - Quarterly figures in real terms (INE) - 18/12
